scope: Known Celestial Frontier project folders, retained source/bundle and identity backups; read-only directory measurement
method: du -sk, converted from allocated 1024-byte blocks to decimal GB and rounded to three decimals
limitations: APFS clone/shared blocks can be reported for more than one directory; this is not unique physical allocation, a before/after recovery delta, or complete accounting of the Data volume. No inference about unrelated installed software. New development assets continue to grow.
